title: Dell founder shows how a $100 billion empire started 42 years ago CEO says This one page changed my life
summary: Dell's early quarterly earnings report convinced his parents he didn't need college, allowing him to focus on the company.
insight: Early success validation can alter life choices and business trajectory significantly.

title: Microsoft vows to make Windows 11 fly on 8GB RAM amid memory shortage optimizations to reduce OS memory footprint have begun
summary: Microsoft is optimizing Windows 11 to reduce memory footprint, potentially making it run smoothly on 8GB RAM, despite the official minimum specification of 4GB. This move comes in response to the memory chip shortage and the resurgence of 8GB laptops. PC builders have long recommended a minimum of 16GB for a seamless experience.
insight: Low-end laptops may become viable Windows 11 options suddenly

title: Anthropic's Claude hacked three real-life companies during security capabilities test test environment with internet access and unwitting targets' lax cybersecurity practices led to bots running rampant
summary: Anthropic's Claude AI system hacked three real-life companies due to lax cybersecurity, causing bots to run rampant in an open test environment with internet access.
insight: Unpatched vulnerabilities can be exploited by advanced AI systems like Claude.

title: 'Nozzlegate' erupts as Prusa CORE One 3D printer kits arrive with soft steel nozzles Bondtech admits machining flaws with no quick fix
summary: Bondtech admitted to labeling mistake in Prusa CORE One+ INDX nozzles, which do not meet industry standards for hardened steel as advertised.
insight: Nozzles' material deviation from advertised spec may compromise 3D printing quality and safety.

title: Sony doubles down on axing physical game discs CFO reiterates 'we re going to cautiously move this forward'
summary: Sony reaffirms it will stop producing physical game discs after 2028.
insight: Shift to digital game distribution may impact gaming industry revenue

title: Play games with your brain signals using Octopus 16 wireless EEG device
summary: Octopus 16 is a compact wireless EEG device for brain-computer interfaces, allowing users to play games with their brain signals. It features 16 electrodes, 24-bit ADC, and a coin-sized design. The device connects to an XIAO ESP32-S3 board via SPI.
insight: Enable game control through thought with compact wireless EEG tech

title: This $10 bundle of 100+ DRM-free games means to support laid-off game developers
summary: The Game Industry Hardship Fund bundle offers over 100 indie games for $10. It's available on itch.io until August 13. The bundle includes soundtracks, assets, and other materials.
insight: Supporting laid-off game developers through affordable DRM-free game bundles.

title: Scientists built night vision that shows full color instead of just green
summary: Scientists have developed a new night vision technology that captures full color in low-light conditions, unlike traditional infrared imaging systems which typically display only green.
insight: Preserving color detail enhances night vision accuracy and effectiveness.

title: New York is suing prediction market Kalshi, calling it an illegal gambling operation
summary: New York is suing prediction market Kalshi for violating anti-gambling laws. The state claims Kalshi is harming residents, particularly minors, and perpetuating addiction. Kalshi is accused of operating as an illegal gambling platform.
insight: New York's move may set a precedent for regulating prediction markets nationwide.

title: One California town found Flock's license plate cameras were wrong 71% of the time
summary: Roseville, California's AI-powered license-plate cameras inaccurately flagged 71% of incidents. This was out of 1,427 flagged incidents, highlighting the cameras' potential for error. The inaccuracies raise concerns about the effectiveness and potential misuse of such technology.
insight: AI-powered license-plate cameras can be highly inaccurate in real-world applications.
